name: SPY Monthly Returns: Rate Direction × VIX Regime
description: 2×2 regime matrix analyzing SPY monthly returns across Rate Direction (10Y yield rising/falling MoM) and Volatility (VIX above/below 20). Uses DGS10 for yield direction and VIXCLS for volatility regime. Classifies each month by end-of-month yield change and average monthly VIX. Outputs: average return bar chart, hit rate bar chart, and detailed summary table (count, avg return, median, hit rate, annualized return, worst/best month) for all 4 regimes.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SPY MONTHLY RETURNS: RATE DIRECTION × VIX REGIME (2×2 MATRIX)
# =============================================================================
# Axis 1 — Rate direction: 10Y Treasury yield (DGS10) rising vs falling MoM
# Axis 2 — Volatility:     VIX (VIXCLS) above vs below 20
#
# 4 Regimes:
#   1. Rising Rates + Low VIX  (calm rate rise)
#   2. Rising Rates + High VIX (stressed rate rise)
#   3. Falling Rates + Low VIX (calm rate fall)
#   4. Falling Rates + High VIX (stressed rate fall)
#
# Monthly classification:
#   - End-of-month DGS10 vs prior month-end DGS10
#   - Average daily VIX over the month
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# MACRO DATA (FRED)
# =============================================================================

# 10Y Treasury yield (daily, use_alfred=False for market data)
dgs10_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
dgs10 = ffill(dgs10_raw.result)

# VIX (daily, use_alfred=False for market data)
vix_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS', use_alfred=False)()
vix = ffill(vix_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# MONTH BOUNDARY DETECTION
# =============================================================================

is_month_end = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(bar_ts)

# =============================================================================
# MONTHLY METRICS (captured at month-end bars)
# =============================================================================

# Monthly SPY return: close now vs close at prior month-end
prior_month_close = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_month_end, close)
monthly_ret_daily = (close - prior_month_close) / prior_month_close
monthly_ret = where(is_month_end, monthly_ret_daily)

# DGS10 direction: current month-end yield vs prior month-end yield
prior_month_yield = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_month_end, dgs10)
yield_change = dgs10 - prior_month_yield
is_rates_rising = where(is_month_end, yield_change > 0)

# VIX regime: 21-day average as proxy for monthly average VIX
vix_ma = ma(period=21)(vix)
is_high_vix = where(is_month_end, vix_ma > 20)

# NaN-safe boolean flags (only on month-end bars)
rates_rising = coalesce(is_rates_rising, False)
rates_falling = not rates_rising
high_vix = coalesce(is_high_vix, False)
low_vix = not high_vix

# =============================================================================
# 4-WAY REGIME CLASSIFICATION (month-end only)
# =============================================================================

is_rise_low   = is_month_end and rates_rising and low_vix
is_rise_high  = is_month_end and rates_rising and high_vix
is_fall_low   = is_month_end and rates_falling and low_vix
is_fall_high  = is_month_end and rates_falling and high_vix

# =============================================================================
# REGIME-FILTERED MONTHLY RETURNS
# =============================================================================

ret_rise_low  = where(is_rise_low, monthly_ret_daily)
ret_rise_high = where(is_rise_high, monthly_ret_daily)
ret_fall_low  = where(is_fall_low, monthly_ret_daily)
ret_fall_high = where(is_fall_high, monthly_ret_daily)

# Hit rate inputs: 1.0 if positive month, 0.0 if not (per regime)
hit_rise_low  = where(is_rise_low, 1.0 if monthly_ret_daily > 0 else 0.0)
hit_rise_high = where(is_rise_high, 1.0 if monthly_ret_daily > 0 else 0.0)
hit_fall_low  = where(is_fall_low, 1.0 if monthly_ret_daily > 0 else 0.0)
hit_fall_high = where(is_fall_high, 1.0 if monthly_ret_daily > 0 else 0.0)

# Count inputs: 1.0 per regime event
cnt_rise_low  = 1.0 if is_rise_low else 0.0
cnt_rise_high = 1.0 if is_rise_high else 0.0
cnt_fall_low  = 1.0 if is_fall_low else 0.0
cnt_fall_high = 1.0 if is_fall_high else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Cards: regime month counts ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Regime Month Counts',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Month Count'],
        col_headers=['Rise+LowVIX', 'Rise+HighVIX', 'Fall+LowVIX', 'Fall+HighVIX'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Rate × VIX Regime'
)(cnt_rise_low, cnt_rise_high, cnt_fall_low, cnt_fall_high)

# --- Chart 1: Average monthly SPY return by regime ---
xy_bars(
    title='Does SPY Handle Rising Rates Differently When VIX Is Calm vs Stressed?',
    category='Rate × VIX Regime',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Monthly Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rise + Low VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rise + High VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fall + Low VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fall + High VIX')
    ])
)(ret_rise_low, ret_rise_high, ret_fall_low, ret_fall_high)

# --- Chart 2: Hit rate (% of positive months) by regime ---
xy_bars(
    title='Which Regime Has the Best Batting Average?',
    category='Rate × VIX Regime',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% Positive Months)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rise + Low VIX', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rise + High VIX', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fall + Low VIX', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fall + High VIX', color=Color.Slate)
    ])
)(hit_rise_low, hit_rise_high, hit_fall_low, hit_fall_high)

# --- Chart 3: Detailed summary table (7 metrics × 4 regimes) ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY Monthly Return Profile by Rate × VIX Regime',
        row_size=7,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Month Count', 'Avg Monthly Return', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Annualized Return', 'Worst Month', 'Best Month'],
        col_headers=['Rise + Low VIX', 'Rise + High VIX', 'Fall + Low VIX', 'Fall + High VIX'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Month count (Sum of 1s)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Avg monthly return (Mean)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Median return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 3: Hit rate (Mean of 1/0 series)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 4: Annualized return (Mean × 12 not directly available, use Mean of annualized series)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 5: Worst month (Min)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 6: Best month (Max)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Rate × VIX Regime'
)(cnt_rise_low, cnt_rise_high, cnt_fall_low, cnt_fall_high, ret_rise_low, ret_rise_high, ret_fall_low, ret_fall_high, ret_rise_low, ret_rise_high, ret_fall_low, ret_fall_high, hit_rise_low, hit_rise_high, hit_fall_low, hit_fall_high, ret_rise_low, ret_rise_high, ret_fall_low, ret_fall_high, ret_rise_low, ret_rise_high, ret_fall_low, ret_fall_high, ret_rise_low, ret_rise_high, ret_fall_low, ret_fall_high)
